documents.title: Office WiFi
documents.text: The office guest WiFi network is 'Acme-Guest' and the password is Sunflower42. It resets on the first Monday of every month.

documents.title: PTO Policy
documents.text: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off per year. PTO accrues monthly and unused days can be carried over, up to a maximum of 5 days into the next year.

documents.title: Expense Reimbursement
documents.text: Submit expense reports through the finance portal within 30 days of purchase. Reimbursements are paid out on the 15th of the following month. Receipts are required for any expense over 25 dollars.

documents.title: Remote Work
documents.text: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Fully remote arrangements require manager approval and are reviewed every 6 months.

documents.title: Security Onboarding
documents.text: All new hires must enable two-factor authentication on their accounts within the first week. Company laptops are encrypted with FileVault and must not be left unlocked in public spaces.
